text: ⑴ $\overline{\mathrm{OB}=\sin \,x°,\,\overline{\mathrm{AB}=\cos \,x°,\,\overline{\mathrm{CD}=\frac{1}{\tan \,x°}}}}$⑵ $\frac{1}{4}$   ⑶ $\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{1}{4}$⑴ $\sin x°=\frac{\overline{OB}}{\overline{OA}=\frac{\overline{OB}}{1}=\overline{\mathrm{OB},\,\overline{\mathrm{OB}=\sin x°\,}}}$ $\cos x°=\frac{\overline{AB}}{\overline{OA}=\frac{\overline{AB}}{1}=\overline{\mathrm{AB},\,\overline{\mathrm{AB}=\cos x°\,}}}$$\tan x°=\frac{\overline{OD}}{\overline{CD}=\frac{1}{\overline{CD},\,\overline{\mathrm{CD}=\frac{1}{\tan x°}}}}$⑵ $\overline{\mathrm{OB}=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2},\,\overline{\mathrm{AB}=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}}}$$\triangle \mathrm{OAB}=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\times \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\times \frac{1}{2}=\frac{1}{4}$⑶ 색칠한 부분의 넓이는$\pi \times 1^{2}\times \frac{90}{360}-\frac{1}{4}=\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{1}{4}$

$14\sqrt{3}\,(\mathrm{c}m^{2})$$\overline{AD}=\overline{DE}=4\left( cm\right) ,\,\overline{BC}=\overline{CE}=3\left( cm\right)$이므로 $\overline{CD}=7\left( cm\right)$점 $\mathrm{C}$에서 $\overline{AD}$에 내린 수선의 발을 $\mathrm{H}$라 하면 $\overline{DH}=1\left( cm\right)$직각삼각형 $\mathrm{CDH}$에서 $\overline{CH}=\sqrt{7^{2}-1^{2}}=4\sqrt{3}\left( cm\right)$사각형 $\mathrm{ABCD}$의 넓이는$\frac{\mathrm{1}}{2}\times \left( 4+3\right) \times 4\sqrt{3}=14\sqrt{3}\left( cm^{2}\right)$

$24\,(\mathrm{c}m)$$\overline{BE}=\overline{BD}=4\left( cm\right) ,\,\overline{CE}=\overline{CF}=6\left( cm\right)$$\overline{\mathrm{AD}=\overline{\mathrm{AF}=x\left( \mathrm{c}m\right) }}$라 하면 $\overline{\mathrm{AB}=x+4\left( \mathrm{cm}\right) }$, $\overline{\mathrm{AC}=x+6\left( \mathrm{c}m\right) }$이므로직각삼각형 $\mathrm{ABC}$에서$\left( x+4\right) ^{2}+\left( x+6\right) ^{2}=10^{2}$$x^{2}+10x-24=0$, $\left( x+12\right) \left( x-2\right) =0$$x=2\,\left( x>0\right)$직각삼각형 $\mathrm{ABC}$둘레의 길이는$6+10+8=24\left( \mathrm{c}m\right)$
